findings.evidence: L132 `@[simp] theorem netCharge_sumElim`, L148 `@[simp] theorem netCharge_chargedLine` vs L200 `theorem eikonalCurrent_sumElim`, L206 `theorem eikonalCurrent_chargedLine`. Both RHSs are strictly smaller/closed-form in the rewritten head, so neither loops.
findings.issue: `eikonalCurrent_sumElim` (L200) and `eikonalCurrent_chargedLine` (L206) carry no `@[simp]`, while their counterparts `netCharge_sumElim` (L132) and `netCharge_chargedLine` (L148) do. These are the normal-form lemmas that decompose a structured leg family, so `simp` reduces `netCharge` of a `Sum.elim`/`chargedLine` but leaves `eikonalCurrent` of the same inert.

findings.evidence: L233 `def elasticLegs ... := Sum.elim (chargedLine K.k K.kPrime eLepton) (chargedLine K.p K.pPrime eHadron)`; L237 `theorem elasticLegs_def` (no `@[simp]`). The parallel `chargedLine` does ship evaluation lemmas: L141 `@[simp] theorem chargedLine_zero`, L144 `@[simp] theorem chargedLine_one`. L18 of Kinematics/Basic.lean uses `@[expose] public section`; this file (L64) does not.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem elasticLegs_inl (i : Fin 2) : K.elasticLegs eL eH (.inl i) = chargedLine K.k K.kPrime eL i` and the matching `elasticLegs_inr`, or mark `elasticLegs_def` `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `elasticLegs` has no per-index evaluation lemma. Its body is not exposed (the file opens with plain `public section`, not `@[expose] public section`), so downstream `simp [elasticLegs]` cannot unfold it and `elasticLegs_def` (L237) is not `@[simp]`. A consumer applying the general `eikonalCurrent_conserved` (L164) or `apply_eikonalCurrent_eikonalCurrent` (L189) to `elasticLegs` — the next §0.5 item, the YFS exponent from `J·J` — cannot evaluate `(elasticLegs K eL eH i).momentum`/`.signedCharge` or discharge the `∀ i, g (L i).momentum ℓ ≠ 0` side condition without first rewriting by hand.

summary: Surface is minimal with no compatibility artifacts and bodies correctly unexposed, but the simp annotations are asymmetric between the netCharge and eikonalCurrent families, and elasticLegs ships no evaluation lemmas despite its body being unexposed.
